name: Fallback and Capture Verification
description: Verify every LLM call site's fallback coverage and JSON capture: forced-failure walks, extraction rescue, placeholder gates — the BitNet coherency sweep.

steps.description: Enumerate every LLM call site and assert each walks a fallback chain (or needs none, like deterministic extractors). Hands on a coverage map.
steps.name: audit_call_sites

steps.description: Plan the forced-failure run: drive pipeline 9 forced to BitNet across each call site's real prompt shape and run the balanced-scan extractor on every response. Hands on the capture report plan and expected results. Running it needs a test capability that is not registered.
steps.name: force_capture

steps.description: Feed shell and placeholder drafts through the persist gates and verify an honest discard with reasons. Hands on the gate report.
steps.name: gate_verification

missing_capabilities: run a test or fresh-process verification against the host (e.g. QueryGraph from a new process, a regression test run)
